provenance.from: The project author's own AMOS Pro installation.
provenance.note: The two identity strings disagree: the embedded $VER cookie says V2.5 Registered while the copyright banner still says 'LDos Pro 1.0'. The $VER cookie is taken as authoritative (it is the string the Amiga Version command reads); the stale banner is recorded so a binary carrying only the banner can still be matched.
provenance.redistribution: Third-party extension, redistribution terms unverified. Kept as a fixture for identification only.

notes: No manual available. Keyword behaviour is therefore inferred from the token table (names + parameter specs) and the library's embedded error strings, which is table-only evidence: keywords implemented from this alone cannot be marked faithful.
